beat: Movies, horror invitation and unexpected Raj farewell hug

lines.original: Sharmi: ohhhhhh, no one is there to watch movies like Raj.... this fellow has even planned to make one room in the second floor into a complete movie theater...hehe
lines.local: Sharmi: Ooh, Raj jaisa movie ka shaukeen koi nahi! Yeh toh second floor mein poora home theatre banaane ki planning kar raha hai. Hehe.

lines.original: John: wow..... Raj, thats a dream come true for all men....
lines.local: John: Wah Raj, yeh toh har aadmi ka sapna hai!

lines.original: Raj: hehe... I know... Once it is ready, I will invite you guys definitely......
lines.local: Raj: Hehe, mujhe pata hai. Taiyaar hote hi tum logon ko pakka bulaunga.

lines.original: John: looking forward Raj..... I love movies too. Especially Horror.
lines.local: John: Intezaar rahega Raj. Mujhe bhi movies pasand hain, khaaskar horror.

lines.original: Raj: Heyyyy,...why don't you guys join us tomorrow. There is a new horror movie coming out tomorrow.
lines.local: Raj: Arey, tum dono kal humare saath kyun nahi chalte? Kal ek nayi horror movie aa rahi hai.

lines.original: Sharmi: oh yes... Dhika please please come...... she knows Dhika is afraid of horror movies...
lines.local: Sharmi: Oh haan! Dhika please, please aana. Use pata tha Dhika horror films se darti hai.

lines.original: John: hehe,... I would love tooo, but Dhika is afraid of horror....
lines.local: John: Hehe, mujhe toh bahut achha lagega, par Dhika horror se darti hai.

lines.original: Dhika blushed and felt awkward.... she didn't want Raj to know that....
lines.local: Dhika awkward ho gayi aur blush kiya; woh nahi chahti thi Raj ko yeh pata chale.

lines.original: Raj: Dhika... if you come, I promise to keep you safe from the ghosts...
lines.local: Raj: Dhika, tum aao toh main vaada karta hoon bhoot se tumhe bachaunga!

lines.original: All started laughing and in the end Dhika agreed to join as it has been so many days she went for a movie and she has indeed went a few times to Horror movies for the sake of her husband... John loves them...
lines.local: Sab hans pade. Aakhir Dhika maan gayi: bahut din se film dekhne nahi gayi thi aur John ki khatir pehle bhi kuch horror movies dekh chuki thi.

lines.original: Sharmi: yessss.... so it is settled then... tomorrrow night at 10 pm...
lines.local: Sharmi: Yesss! Tay ho gaya, kal raat 10 baje.

lines.original: It was getting late and Pappu didn't wake up at all.... John and Dhika said their byes and stood up to leave.... Raj was escorting Dhika out while Sharmi took sleeping Pappu in her hands and headed towards their car.... John went ahead with her to open the car door....
lines.local: Der ho rahi thi aur Pappu poore waqt nahi jaaga tha. John aur Dhika bye bolkar nikalne lage. Raj Dhika ko bahar chhodne gaya; Sharmi ne sote hue Pappu ko uthaaya aur car ki taraf chali. John door kholne aage gaya.

lines.original: At their car, with Pappu sleeping at the back, John bid bye to Raj and gave a light hug and pat and when he turned, Sharmi hugged John into a tight embrass..... and while leaving him, she winked and smiled at him....
lines.local: Car tak pahunchkar Pappu ko back seat par sula diya. John ne Raj ko bye bolkar halka hug aur pat diya; palta toh Sharmi ne John ko bahut kas kar hug kiya aur alag hote hue wink aur smile di.

lines.original: Raj was turning to shook Dhika's hands to say good bye to her ...but to everyone's surprise, she gave him a hug..... not like Sharmi... but a light one...
lines.local: Raj Dhika se goodbye handshake karne mud raha tha; sab hairaan reh gaye jab Dhika ne khud use halka hug de diya—Sharmi waale tight hug jaisa nahi.
Sharmi: Ek aur bada step! Hehe.

lines.original: Hitting Sharmi for teasing her.... Dhika and John got into the car and left for their house.....
lines.local: Dhika ne Sharmi ko chhedne par halke se maara, phir woh aur John car mein baithkar ghar ke liye nikal gaye.
